name: Keokia Childress
office: City of Inglewood, Member of the City Council, 1st District

items.text: Keokia Childress is a small-business owner. She has served as an Inglewood Housing Commissioner for eight years. She co-founded the Taste of Inglewood festival and founded Keokia’s Kitchen. She wants to preserve affordable housing and repurpose vacant properties. She proposes clustering new developments near transit and job centers. She supports small businesses and transparent city government. She pledges to hold community meetings and provide regular public updates. She opposes Measure BB.
